header.running_head: Rasulullaah ﷺ is Particular about Dispatching the Army of Hadhrat Usaama bin Zaid (RA) even on his Deathbed, after which Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) also Gives the Same Importance to the Matter When he Becomes the Khalifah

Some of the Ansaar said to Hadhrat Umar (RA) that if Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) is determined to dispatch the army, he should convey the message from them that an Ameer who is older than Hadhrat Usaama (RA) should be appointed.
Upon the instruction of Hadhrat Usaama (RA), Hadhrat Umar (RA) proceeded to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and informed him about what Hadhrat Usaama (RA) had said. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) said, "I would not reverse a decision that Rasulullaah ﷺ made even if wild dogs and wolves were to snatch away my body." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then said, "The Ansaar have requested me to convey the message that they want you to appoint an Ameer over them who is elder than Usaama." Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) had been sitting, but (when he heard this, he) sprang up and grabbed hold of the beard of Hadhrat Umar (RA). He then said, "May your mother lose you, O son of Khattaab! You are asking me to relieve him of a post to which Rasulullaah ﷺ appointed him?!" When Hadhrat Umar (RA) returned and the people asked him what had happened, he said, "March on. May your mothers lose you because of what I have suffered today at the hands of the Khalifah of Rasulullaah ﷺ on your account."
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) Sees the Army of Hadhrat Usaama (RA) Off

Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) then proceeded to see the army off and to give them encouragement. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) walked as Hadhrat Usaama (RA) rode while Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA) led Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)'s animal. Hadhrat Usaama (RA) said, "O Khalifah of Rasulullaah ﷺ! Either you ride or I dismount." Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied, "By Allaah! You should not dismount. By Allaah! I shall not ride. What harm is there if I make my feet dusty for a while in the path of Allaah? In fact, every step taken by the person leaving in Jihaad earns the reward of seven hundred good deeds, has his ranks raised by seven hundred stages and erases seven hundred sins from his account."
When he was about to leave, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) asked, "If you feel that you could help me by leaving Umar bin Khattaab with me, could you please do so." Hadhrat Usaama (RA) granted permission. [^1]
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) Rejects the Request of the Muhaajireen and Ansaar to hold back the Army of Hadhrat Usaama (RA)
